title: Eddie C
requirements: Translation of vector outline designs (EPS/AI files) into high-fidelity 3D assets for physical bobblehead merchandise. The deliverables consisted of a custom rockstar silhouette with accompanying stage equipment, guitars, and accessory pieces measured to a target six-inch display spec. The geometry had to be entirely watertight to comply with physical printing constraints.
achievements: Successfully extruded flat vector artwork into rich, fully balanced three-dimensional forms
Created completely solid, watertight meshes without self-intersecting manifolds
Optimized file formats to support immediate slicing on industrial 3D printing equipment
